synopsis: The Waymo Open Dataset serves as an on-road example of reproducible reference practice in both Chapter 7 and the glossary [f5360, f12821, f15722]. The reference elements include synchronized lidar and camera data, calibration, vehicle poses and tracked labels, with Chapter 7 and one glossary entry explicitly specifying 3D labels [f5360, f12821, f15722]. Chapter 7 additionally identifies refined object poses as a reference element [f5360]. This example is not off-road certification evidence, so its role in the corpus is illustrative rather than proof of off-road certification [f5361].

relations.note: Both identify the same reproducible reference elements, with Chapter 7 adding detail.
Both list synchronized sensors, calibration, vehicle poses and tracked 3D labels.
Glossary entries restate the reference requirements; one specifies 3D labels.
Clarifies that the on-road reference example is not off-road certification evidence.
Limits the certification relevance of the reproducible reference example.
